fields.quote: Of these 10 patients, 9 patients had the TLR4 Asp299Gly polymorphism and 8 patients had the TLR4 Thr399Ile polymorphism. PCR products containing the Asp299Gly (n ＝ 9) and Thr399Ile (n ＝ 8) polymorphisms were sequenced. However, DNA sequencing of these PCR products did not show the presence of these SNPs.

items.item_note: The paper says nothing about adjustment. The result is a raw descriptive genotype tally (Table 1: 9 genotyped cases, all A/A at nucleotide 1063) with no statistical model. So A's 'no' (unadjusted) and B's 'not_stated' are both consistent with the paper.
